scenarios.description: The test's first-outing base and orders; the player queues each craft as soon as its inputs are in the store (checked every 0.25 s). Ends when the kit is ready and depart() succeeds.
scenarios.driver: tick(0.25) repeatedly; calls are made after the tick that reaches their t, snapshots after the calls at the same t
scenarios.name: first_outing

scenarios.description: Identical calls to first_outing at identical times; time between events passes in one long tick.
scenarios.driver: one tick(gap) from each call or snapshot time to the next; gaps are at most 30 s
scenarios.name: first_outing_long_ticks

scenarios.description: A spring and a qi urn, no food and no well; repeating haul and cultivate orders for 20 minutes.
scenarios.name: hunger_only

scenarios.description: Spring, well, a grain field inside a closed conduit ring and one outside it on the same network; the cultivator hauls water and harvests both.
scenarios.driver: tick(0.25) repeatedly; snapshots every 30 s; derived.batches_finished counts each field's finished batches (exporter-side count, not sim state)
scenarios.name: conduit_ring

scenarios.description: No orders at all. The mouse alone gathers qi and water, pours them into a grain field and a (staffed, so idle) hearth, and harvests.
scenarios.driver: tick(0.25) repeatedly; one click every 0.5 s cycling spring, well, field, hearth; snapshots every 30 s after that time's click
scenarios.name: mouse_only
